To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have developed a Configurable DSS capable of modeling generic problems in a deterministic and in an uncertain context, and of simulating future real uncertainty to evaluate performance of solutions under real uncertainty.
the proposed Configurable DSS for uncertainty management can be used by DM to choose the best solution for the problem under analysis.
the Configurable DSS for uncertainty management by Fuzzy Sets is a new approach to model-based decision support for uncertainty management by fuzzy sets.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a Configurable DSS capable of generating different models for different situations, and allowing the DM to choose the best solution for each situation.

the development of a Configurable Model-based DSS that allows the DM to deal with the uncertainty in the problem data, to assess the performance of generated solutions, and to choose the most adequate one.
the development of a DSS for uncertainty management by means of fuzzy sets.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the DSS is capable of providing a set of solutions that can satisfy the needs of DM in the face of uncertainty, thus contributing to the success of decision-making process.

the proposed DSS allows the DM to choose the best solution to be implemented in real situations by means of the analysis of the performance of the solutions obtained from deterministic and equivalent crisp models.

the DSS proposed in this paper is capable of dealing with uncertainty in data by means of fuzzy sets in the model development stage, as well as in the performance assessment stage, and it is capable of generating projections of the performance of solutions in hypothetical real situations, allowing a better choice of the best solution to be implemented.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have designed a DSS capable of supporting the DM to solve problems modeled in a deterministic and/or uncertain context.
a DSS capable of managing uncertainty in data and of assessing performance of solutions is proposed.
we propose a DSS for solving generic problems modeled by LP and by FS in deterministic and uncertain contexts, respectively.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the DSS allows DM to choose a solution based on the performance of solutions for planned and real situations.
the DSS allows a DM to make better decisions by simulating future real uncertainty.
the DSS is able to generate solutions to be implemented in real world problems.
